fields.FIR_Description: According to the complaint registered on 2026-05-29, the complainant invested Rs. 12,00,000 in a scheme promising fixed monthly returns, but payouts stopped after two months. The incident is stated to have occurred on 2026-05-24 at roughly 11:05. Madhan Rajan submitted the complaint online using the mobile number 9000000143. The complaint refers to Divya Murugan, a neighbour, reachable on 9000000333. No independent witness was identified at the time of registration. The complainant alleged that Ajith Nathan may be involved and provided the mobile number 9000000297. Records suggest a possible link with FIR-2026-00398, as the mobile number 9000000297 is associated with a suspect in both entries.
fields.Modus_Operandi: Scheme reportedly promoted through a messaging group.
fields.Keywords: investment fraud, high returns, associate, suspect, documents, morning, mobile number, residential colony
